title: When the Vehicle Leaves the Holder: End of KestrelCare Plan Use
content:
**Clause.** For a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts cancellation, the day to which the plan's use is counted is set as follows:

- where the covered vehicle was traded in to Kestrel, use is counted to the pickup date on that trade-in agreement;
- where the covered vehicle came back to Kestrel under a 7-day return, use is counted to the date its purchase order closed as returned;
- otherwise use is counted to the cancellation request date.

A trade-in of the covered vehicle is a Trade-In Agreements agreement whose vehicle is the plan's VIN; its pickup date is the date the vehicle was picked up or dropped at a hub. A 7-day return shows on the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order as an order closed with the status returned, with its closing date. This day ends the use counted for the time measure; the miles measure still reads the odometer on the cancellation request.

| What the records show for the covered vehicle | Use counted to |
|---|---|
| a trade-in agreement for the VIN with a pickup date | that pickup date |
| no trade-in; purchase order closed as returned | the date the purchase order closed |
| neither | the cancellation request date |

*Hypothetical:* a holder traded the covered car in to Kestrel with pickup on 9 August and asked to cancel on 25 August; use runs to 9 August.
